top_choice_rationale: P001 honours the discovery layer of GLP-1 physiology (Holst on secretion and action in humans, Drucker on proglucagon-derived peptide and receptor biology, Mojsov on the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide) that explains why incretin-based therapy of type 2 diabetes and obesity works. The work is original, replicated for decades and confirmed in large outcome trials, and the citation can be scoped to physiology and the active form without adjudicating the Habener priority question. No award would leave an exceptionally mature achievement unrecognised.
